title: Gtemos
description: Gnotas is a professional Terms of Service and acceptance plugin for Paper/Purpur servers.
body:
Gnotas — Professional Terms & Acceptance System for Minecraft Servers

Gnotas is a lightweight yet powerful plugin designed to make your Minecraft server look more professional by introducing a complete Terms of Service and player acceptance system. Ensure that every player reads and agrees to your rules before fully accessing your community.

Built for Paper and Purpur 1.21.4, Gnotas provides an elegant onboarding experience with multilingual support, Bedrock compatibility, automatic reminders, and advanced administrative controls — all without external dependencies.

✨ Features
📜 Terms of Service System
Players can view your server's Terms of Service using:
/gtermos
/termos
/terms
Accept the terms with:
/gaceitar
/aceitar
/accept
Supports customizable terms directly from the configuration files.
🎮 Player Experience
✅ Automatic Terms Book for Java Edition players.
✅ Chat-based terms display for Bedrock players.
✅ Chat is blocked until the player accepts the terms.
✅ Fireworks celebration upon acceptance.
✅ Titles and sound effects for a polished experience.
✅ Periodic reminder messages for players who have not accepted yet.
🌍 Multilingual Support

Gnotas comes ready with three built-in languages:

🇧🇷 Portuguese (pt_BR)
🇺🇸 English (en_US)
🇪🇸 Spanish (es_ES)

Adding new languages is simple through the messages folder.

📱 Bedrock Compatibility

Using Floodgate detection, Gnotas automatically adapts the experience for Bedrock players by displaying terms directly through chat instead of books.

This ensures a seamless experience across both Java and Bedrock editions.

🔧 Administrative Tools

Available through:

/gnotas
/gn

Administrator features include:

/gnotas ajuda — View all commands.
/gnotas recarregar — Reload configurations and messages.
/gnotas versao — Display plugin version.
/gnotas resetar <player> — Reset a player's acceptance.
/gnotas resetar-todos — Reset acceptance for everyone.
/gnotas checar <player> — Check a player's acceptance status.
/gnotas forcar <player> — Force acceptance.
/gnotas pendentes — List players who haven't accepted.
/gnotas atualizar — Increment the Terms version and require everyone to accept again.
🔄 Terms Version System

Whenever your server rules change, simply run:

/gnotas atualizar

All players will automatically be required to accept the updated Terms of Service again, ensuring everyone stays informed about policy changes.

⚡ Lightweight & Efficient
No external dependencies.
Extremely lightweight (~43 KB).
Optimized for performance.
Easy to configure and maintain.
Fully compatible with Paper/Purpur 1.21.4.
📦 Installation
Place Gnotas.jar inside your server's plugins/ folder.
Start your server.
The plugin will automatically generate:
plugins/Gnotas/
├── config.yml
├── messages/
│   ├── pt_BR.yml
│   ├── en_US.yml
│   └── es_ES.yml
└── player_data.yml
Customize the settings to fit your server.
Use:
/ gnotas recarregar

to apply your changes instantly.

🚀 Why Choose Gnotas?

Gnotas helps transform a simple Minecraft server into a more professional and organized community. By requiring players to acknowledge your rules and policies, you improve transparency, reduce misunderstandings, and create a better onboarding experience for everyone.

Whether you're running a small community or a large network, Gnotas provides the tools you need to manage Terms of Service elegantly and efficiently.
